joint.outcome: theorem from standard axioms with no shared-scope hypotheses: consistent with every satisfiable law set

law.statement_en: Boyle's law for a closed swim bladder at fixed temperature with hydrostatic pressure p0 + k d: the volume at depth d is V0 p0 / P(d), so a closed bladder claiming more volume at depth is ruled out (quasi-static only).

hypotheses.name: see theorem statement
hypotheses.statement: the named hypothesis structure(s) in the theorem statement; instantiated with fetched numbers in Delphi.Perturb.measured

scope.basis: gas physics (Boyle) with 1 atm per 10 m of seawater (Yancey 2020); quasi-static only: fails for rapid decompression (Kerr 2023)
